newsitem.title: UK: UK March oil output down for third month - newsletter.
newsitem.headline: UK March oil output down for third month - newsletter.

text.p: British oil production fell for the third month in succession in March against expectations of increased flows from new fields, industry newsletter the Aberdeen Petroleum Report (APR) said on Friday.

U.K. crude and natural gas liquids output in March slipped fractionally to 2.592 million barrels a day (bpd) down just 16,000 bpd from 2.608 million in February, APRs survey of North Sea operators found.
Production was 150,000 bpd below a recent high set in December at 2.741 million. Output fell to 2.686 million in January.
Supply in March from BP's Harding field was cut in half to 35,100 bpd by gas compression problems.
A six-month test of production from Conoco's Banff stopped in mid-March.
Texaco contributed 18,437 bpd from its new Captain field which is expected to reach a plateau at 60,000 bpd.
